A DOINGZZ series

CommonThread

The everyday things Ghanaians live with, explained simply. What it is, how it works, and what it means for us.

Short explainer episodes and carousels built on real voices, real footage and clear motion graphics. Each full episode goes out on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, with a carousel the day after.

Ghana Now

What's changing around us: rent, money, transport, new rules and the news that touches daily life.

Builders

Ghanaians making things: founders, inventors, products and the stories that should travel further.

Beyond Ghana

What's happening in the wider world, and what it means for us here.

For brands

Put your brand inside the story.

Ghanaians already watch Common Thread to understand how things work. A partnership explains your product or idea in the same clear, honest way, to the people who use it every day.

Episode

Brand explainer

A full episode on how your product or service works and what it changes for an ordinary Ghanaian.

Like our MoMo explainer: what actually happens when money is sent.

Profile

Builders feature

The story behind your company, founder or invention, told as a Builders episode.

Like our GhanaSat-1 story.

Series

Ghanaian apps you can try

Your app featured in a category round-up, shown in real use on screen.

Categories such as productivity, payments, accessibility and games.

Posts

Brand news & carousels

Clean, readable news posts and swipe-throughs on launches, deals and milestones.

Like our TraffiTech-GH fines carousel.

How a partnership works

  • The full episode on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube
  • A follow-up carousel the day after the episode
  • Clearly labelled as a partnership. We explain, we don't fake reviews.
Talk to us on WhatsAppEmail & phone
  1. BriefYou tell us what you want people to understand, and who they are.
  2. ScriptWe research and write the episode, and you approve the facts before we produce.
  3. ProductionVoices, footage and motion graphics, edited in Common Thread's style.
  4. ReleaseWe publish across the channels and send you the links and the numbers.
A DOINGZZ podcast & clip series

Charle We Move

Voice notes and short talks about hustle, growth and building the life you want, cut into clips you can feel in the first five seconds.

Where it lives

  • Audio on SpotifyShorter audio versions of the talks.
  • Video on TikTok, Reels and ShortsClips played over our own footage of Accra streets, landmarks and process shots.
  • Vibe CheckHot takes and memes between the clips.
  • The 3-Year RuleA clip series cut from a long talk with community builder Ekaytism, used with permission.
